description.value: The City of Fort St. John's official Visitor Information Centre sits along the Alaska Highway corridor in northeastern BC, one of the most remote stretches of long-distance cycling in the province. Operated by the municipality, it serves as the primary resource for travellers seeking local maps, route guidance, and regional attractions in the Peace River country. For cycle tourists riding the Alaska Highway or connecting routes through the Peace region, this centre is a logical stop for orientation and local knowledge.
